summary: The note describes Magbass, a farming town in Tonkolili District in Sierra Leone's Northern Province, located about 55 miles from Freetown. It highlights the Magbass Sugar Complex, described as one of the largest sugar-producing plantations in West Africa, which provides employment across Tonkolili District and Sierra Leone.
one_line: Magbass is a farming town in Tonkolili District, Sierra Leone, home to the Magbass Sugar Complex, a major West African sugar plantation.
key_facts: Magbass is a farming town in Tonkolili District in the Northern Province of Sierra Leone.
Magbass is located about 55 miles from Freetown.
The town is home to the Magbass Sugar Complex.
The Magbass Sugar Complex is described as one of the largest sugar producing plantations in West Africa.
The Magbass Sugar Complex factory provides employment for a number of people within Tonkolili District.
The Magbass Sugar Complex factory provides employment for a number of people across Sierra Leone.
